name: calendar
description: A scheduling calendar. Rescheduling means updating an event, not cancelling it; cancelling is destructive.

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search events by free text, attendee, or subject. Read-only. Use when you do not have the event id.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Fetch a single event by its exact event id. Read-only.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Check an attendee's free/busy availability before scheduling. Read-only.

tools.name: create_event
tools.description: Create a new event. Use for a genuinely new meeting, not to move an existing one.

tools.name: update_event
tools.description: Update an existing event, including moving or rescheduling it to a new time. Use this to reschedule rather than cancelling and recreating.

tools.name: cancel_event
tools.description: Cancel and remove an event. Destructive. Only call when explicitly asked to cancel or delete a meeting, not to move it.

tools.name: send_invite
tools.description: Send a calendar invite for an existing event to a recipient.
